ticket: Hi, I need to know what data you’re storing about my patients and staff—last month I saw a pop-up about GDPR compliance and got nervous. We’re thinking about switching to another practice management system because we’re not sure how long you keep records or who can access them. Can you send me a full copy of everything you have on us? Also, if we decide to leave, how do we make sure all our data is erased completely? It’s important we’re not breaking any laws.
Export to CSV fails — shows blank file. Workaround: copy-paste from board view. Also, the sidebar keeps collapsing when I click away.
Why is there a $120 tax charge on my March invoice? I already paid taxes on this in my state. Fix this or send a corrected invoice.

Our team use Northbeam for job tracking, but the calendar sync is broken. Every time we add new job, it does not show on Google Calendar. We are using manual export as workaround, but it is very slow. We are thinking to switch to another tool because of this. Please fix soon.

Hey, so I've been trying to get the weekly team report to export properly, but it keeps showing up with the wrong dates—like it's pulling from last month instead of this week—and I’ve had to manually fix each one every time, which is a nightmare since we have to send it to the accountant by Friday. I tried refreshing and clearing cache, but it’s still doing it, though I just realized if I change the date filter to 'last 7 days' it kinda works, so I’m using that workaround for now.

Northbeam down for entire team, login page shows 503 error, API returning 502s across all endpoints, dashboards blank for everyone, urgent — can't track fulfillment timelines, order #NB-882104 affected, no workarounds, whole team blocked

Hi, I'm unable to log in to our Northbeam account — I keep getting stuck in a password reset loop, and I've lost my 2FA authentication device. I’ve tried resetting through the email link multiple times, but it doesn’t seem to work. I’m the primary accountant managing our subscription, and I’m concerned about missing upcoming deadlines. I’ve been looking at other tools like [Competitor A] as an alternative, but I’d prefer to stay with Northbeam if we can resolve this. Could you help me regain access soon?

Hi Northbeam support, I'm locked out of my account and can't get back in. I tried resetting my password multiple times, but I keep getting redirected back to the login page with no error. I also lost my 2FA authentication device, so I can't complete the verification step. I'm the only person on my team using Northbeam, so this is blocking all my project tracking. Could you help me reset my access?

We need a way to assign tasks to specific team members with due dates, not just drag them onto a board. It's been a mess since we started using Northbeam, and my assistant Sarah keeps getting overwhelmed with the same tasks. This isn't a bug—it's just missing a basic feature. You’re a project tool, not a whiteboard. Add task assignments with deadlines, please.

Hey, so my whole team’s been locked out all morning—none of us can even get to the login page, it just spins and then says 503. I tried from two different devices and the office Wi-Fi, same thing. We had a big client meeting scheduled for 9:30 and now we’re scrambling. I saw your status page is green but that doesn’t help us—we’re completely frozen. Oh, and my invoice #NB-88921 just got marked as unpaid, which is weird because we paid last week. But honestly, none of that matters right now because we can’t even use the app.
Gantt chart shifts days randomly. Happens after refresh. No data loss. Can still work around it. How long to fix?

Hi, we're having a strange issue with SSO where the user avatar sometimes shows up as a blank square for a few seconds after login—seems intermittent. It's not affecting functionality, but it’s a little jarring for our team. I’ve tested it on multiple devices and browsers. The last time it happened, I noted the session ID: SSO-78921-456. Could you look into the UI rendering glitch? Thanks for your help.
